scope.note: 116 boards store player_draws.npz and 5 more (2026_01_SF_LA/*) store player_draws.npz.gz. A sweep matching only *.npz misses those 5. All 121 carry board.json pipeline_status == SEALED.

definitions.impossible: violates an arithmetic identity of the box score or a rule of the game. Never justified by plausibility or by what a good forecast ought to look like.
definitions.suspicious: inside the rules but outside the support of 5 seasons of realised games at the same conditioning count, or structurally degenerate. A suspicious cell is NOT a defect on its own: a Monte Carlo engine is supposed to produce extreme draws.
definitions.yardage_bound_derivation: a completed forward pass gains or loses at most 99 yards: the line of scrimmage can sit at most on either 1-yard line, and the play ends between the two goal lines, so per-completion yardage is bounded to [-99,+99] and a game total to [-99*cmp, +99*cmp]. This is the only HARD yardage bound available; it is deliberately loose and it does NOT catch D19. D19 is therefore classified SUSPICIOUS, not impossible, contradicting the wording of the D19 entry.
definitions.empirical_support_bound: yards-per-completion support measured on 3,787 QB games, seasons 2020-2025, from nfl/research/qb2/qb.pkl, banded by the completion count that produced it. Not a threshold chosen to make a number look bad: it is the observed min/max of the same statistic at the same count.

d19.generator_code: ypc_d = _mix(rng, r['h_ypc'], po['ypc'], w, m, ew); PY = CMP * ypc_d
d19.mechanism: PY is not a per-completion yardage draw. One GAME-LEVEL yards-per-completion ratio is resampled whole -- from the QB own history with probability w = h_games/(h_games+K), K=4.0, otherwise from the positional pool -- and multiplied by a completion count drawn independently. The ratio carries no record of the completion count that produced it and is not weighted by it.

pool_negatives.note: every negative pool entry comes from a 1- or 2-completion game

d19.exact_arithmetic: -2.0 is a pool value four times over (2024 WAS 1 cmp for -2; 2024 CAR 2 cmp for -4; 2024 NE 1 cmp for -2; 2025 ARI 1 cmp for -2). -2.0 x 16 completions = -32.0 exactly.

bo_nix_own_history.implication: the draw came from the POOL branch, not his own history

d19.hypothesis_tested_and_REJECTED: The brief asked whether the negative tail is a symmetric-distribution artifact -- a Normal or similar fitted to a right-skewed quantity. It is NOT. No distribution is fitted anywhere on this path. _mix is an empirical resample with replacement of realised game-level ratios, so every value it can emit was observed in a real NFL game. Q7 per-reception skew 2.197 / excess kurtosis 7.830 describes the RECEIVING path, which is a different generator and is not what produced this cell. The defect is not distributional shape; it is SCALE NON-EXCHANGEABILITY -- a ratio estimated at n=1 completion applied at n=16 completions with no shrinkage and no denominator weighting.

d19_blast_radius_correction.d19_claim: 2,261 negative cells sit on QB-only boards and exactly ONE sits on a board carrying the shared passing event; the invariant that every negative passing-yard cell lives on a run WITHOUT the shared passing event is now false, by one cell.
d19_blast_radius_correction.measured: The 2,262 total reproduces EXACTLY. The inference does not. C3 binds per TEAM-SIDE, not per board. Board d1e2727743c93990 carries a receiving layer for KC only (13 KC receivers, 0 DEN); Bo Nix is DEN. Measured per team-side: 104 sides are C3-bound (team qb pyds equals team receiving yards to 5.7e-14) and 2 sides are not. ZERO of the 2,262 negative cells sit on a C3-bound side; all 2,262 sit on a side with no receiving layer. The invariant HOLDS, exactly, at the level that generates the number.
d19_blast_radius_correction.verdict: D19 blast_radius should be corrected. The cell is not an exception to the invariant; board d1e2727743c93990 is simply the first board in the corpus that carries C3 for one of its two teams only.
d19_blast_radius_correction.also: D19 presents itself as 1 cell in 1,000 on ONE board. The same mechanism produces 156 cells at or below -30 yards and 2,262 in total across the corpus. The cell was flagged because a fence happened to be pointed at that board, not because it is rare.

second_finding_upper_tail.statement: The same generator contaminates the RIGHT tail, harder, and no fence points at it.
second_finding_upper_tail.interpretation: 2,016 of 2,140 out-of-support cells (94.2%) trace to a donor game with exactly ONE completion. The left tail has 156 cells worse than -30 yards; the right tail has 680 cells above the all-time NFL single-game record. By magnitude the right tail is the larger defect.

downstream.unit: QB row on a non-C3 side, 1000 draws each

d19_cell_alone.verdict: NEGLIGIBLE. One cell in a thousand moves the mean by +0.24 yards (0.12%) and no threshold probability by more than 0.07 percentage points. Reported as negligible because it is negligible.

crps_and_pit.why: player_draws.npz stores the FULL 1000 simulated draws per row, not nine percentiles, so CRPS is exact rather than approximated.
crps_and_pit.log_score: NOT AVAILABLE without a smoothing choice. A 1000-draw empirical measure with atoms at zero has no density; any log score would be scoring a kernel the engine never declared.
crps_and_pit.pit: NOT ASSESSABLE here. Only 20 QB-game passing lines in this repository have a realised outcome, all 2026 week 1, and PIT on 20 clustered observations measures nothing.
crps_and_pit.outcomes_available: nfl/research/postgame/pbp_2026.1415dd98ba7f701a.csv.gz carries 10 of the 15 week-1 games. It has ZERO DEN and ZERO KC rows and was retrieved 2026-09-14T00:25:56Z, before the 2026-09-15T00:15Z kickoff, so the DEN@KC result is not in this repository and was not used.

crps_measured.CAVEAT: n = 9 rows over 9 games. This establishes NOTHING about whether cleaning improves forecast quality. It is reported because it was measured, with its n, and it must not be quoted as evidence either way.

claims_in_the_brief_corrected.104_sealed_boards: There are 121 sealed boards, not 104. 116 store player_draws.npz and 5 (2026_01_SF_LA) store player_draws.npz.gz. 109 sit under a game directory and 12 under REPLAY_C1. The number 104 matches the count of C3-BOUND TEAM-SIDES, which is a different population; it also equals 116 minus the 12 REPLAY_C1 boards, so two different derivations land on it by coincidence.
claims_in_the_brief_corrected.2261_on_qb_only_boards_one_on_a_C3_board: True as stated about BOARDS and misleading as an inference. Per team-side, 2,262 of 2,262 are on sides with no receiving layer and 0 of 2,262 are on a C3-bound side.
claims_in_the_brief_corrected.149_of_1000_carries_exceed_team_level: NOT REPRODUCIBLE on the sealed corpus. Source located: nfl/research/v2/d1/D1_DEN_UNIVERSE.md:175, which measured an in-flight D1 research build, not a board under nfl/research/live. Measured here over 104 team-sides x 1000 draws = 132,000: 314 draws (0.238%) deal named rushers more carries than team_volume/team_carries, worst excess 0.743 carries and ZERO draws exceeding by a full carry. The D1 figure of "up to 6.12 carries" does not appear anywhere in the sealed corpus. The comparison is also int-vs-float: team_carries is a continuous level (non-integrality up to 0.495) and dealt carries are int16, so a sub-carry excess is a representation mismatch, not a lost carry.
claims_in_the_brief_corrected.negative_yardage_counts_in_draw_coherenc: draw_coherence.py:47 states 2,261 negative qb/pyds, 2,821 qb/ryds and 8,213 receiving yards over 68 runs without the shared passing event. Measured now over all 121 boards: 2,262 qb/pyds, 3,353 qb/ryds, 11,479 receiving yards. The docstring is stale, not wrong -- boards have been added since it was written.

market_boundary.statement: No market feed exists in this system and no sportsbook data is in this repository. board.json carries its own threshold_disclaimer to that effect. No price was fetched, no line was estimated, no edge was computed, and nothing here is a wager recommendation.
market_boundary.what_can_be_said: Only a property of our own distribution: which stored quantities are contaminated in the region an external threshold would sit.

den_kc_question.asked: are the two most recent DEN@KC boards better, worse or the same as the corpus?
den_kc_question.answer: BETTER, and for a traceable reason, not by luck.
den_kc_question.reason: the 50 contaminated boards call nfl/production/nonqb/shared_pass.py:172 credit_to_passers, which splits team completions multinomially on ATTEMPT SHARE (sampling a finite pool WITH replacement) and splits yards on the same attempt share independent of the completion draw. The 3 clean boards call nfl/production/nonqb/football_engine.py:84 credit_passing_line, which allocates by multivariate hypergeometric over (attempts - interceptions), then TDs over credited completions, then yards on the COMPLETION share, and asserts cmp<=att, cmp<=att-int, ptd<=cmp and cmp==0 -> pyds==0 on the values it is about to write (lines 285-300). The repair is already in the tree and already effective; the older boards predate it.
den_kc_question.remaining_gap: 96954efc523bd7d3 is clean on every check in this census. d1e2727743c93990 differs only by the single qb_v1 pyds cell, which sits on the DEN side that credit_passing_line never touches because DEN has no receiving layer.

rush_category_sum_vs_team_carries.classification: NOT impossible. The A1 category budget UNDER-allocates relative to the published team level; it never over-allocates by a full carry. This is the divergence draw_coherence.py:591-597 already names: football_engine._team_carries returns the SC1-coupled vector while run_forecast seals D1 raw vector into team_volume/team_carries. Two layers answering the same question differently, already declared.

fixes_proposed_none_applied.problem: PY = CMP * ypc_d applies a game-level ratio estimated at any completion count to a completion count drawn independently.
options: weight the _mix resample by the donor game completion count, so a 1-completion game cannot carry the same mass as a 30-completion game
shrink each donor ratio toward the pooled rate by its own completion count, n/(n+k), the same shrinkage form this file already uses for w

replace the product with a per-completion yardage draw, so game yardage is a sum of cmp draws rather than a scalar multiple -- this also removes the zero conditional dispersion of pyds given cmp and the 22.75% non-integrality
fixes_proposed_none_applied.NOT_a_fix: clipping pyds at zero or at any -k. D19 test_required already says so and it is right: the check must go to zero by construction.
fixes_proposed_none_applied.note: all three options change the predictive distribution and are mechanism changes, not patches. None applied.

fixes_proposed_none_applied.proposal: no code change needed -- football_engine.credit_passing_line already replaces it and is already coherent by construction. What is missing is that the 50 sealed boards carry the defect and nothing marks them. Propose a board-level provenance flag naming which credit function produced the qb passing line, so a consumer can refuse the old ones.
